name: XRP late spot-confirmed favourite
description: Buys the XRP favourite (YES or NO) once per market with 4-6 minutes left, only when spot is at least 1.5 sigma (15-min realized vol) past the strike. sol-zfav's rule moved unchanged to XRP; held to settlement.
hypothesis: XRP 15m favourites at tau 240-360 s with spot >=1.5 sigma beyond the strike win more often than their ask implies. Dev screen (Feb-Aug, taker next fills net of fee, research dataset, no tuning): tau 360 +2.54c (626 trades, se 0.41, 7/7 months), 300 +1.41c (588, 6/7), 240 +1.56c (388, 6/7). Other side: flat-vol quoters / favourite-longshot payers. Wrong if engine depth/latency erase it, <60% months positive, 2x latency negative, or it decays like SOL (+3.1 -> +0.7c in the lockbox). DOGE was screened and is negative (-1c), not traded.
